issue_context.title: Pd's /status/region may be frequently called when TiFlash is not up
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

Let TiFlash down after a table is ready.

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

Pd's log print print in about 2 secs per table.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

Many logs printed on Pd for single table.

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

nightly
<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

review_comments: Why does removing elements solve this problem?

The outside loop will iterate for `min(pollMaxCount, UpdatingProgressTables.Len())`. If we `continue` here, the loop will go on with `pollMaxCount -= 1`. However the iterator of `UpdatingProgressTables` will not be advanced. That means the same element will be handled for `pollMaxCount` times.

The `Remove` + `Next` mainly follows some previous lines in this method. I believe someone forgets to add these lines here.

We have to remove this element from the queue, no matter whether we have successfully handled it. Otherwise it will be stuck in the queue. If so, the queue will not be updated.

We have observed many requests of the same table to PD in less than 1 sec.

Do we have test for this logic? If it hard to add UT, please add a manual test description.
Rest LGTM.
